# kavynUI - full component index

> 101 components in 12 families. Copy any file into a React + Tailwind project and ship it. Source and docs: https://kavynui.com

## Sections

- [Product Hero](https://kavynui.com/components/product-hero): Headline and actions beside an app window running a deploy. Use case: SaaS landing page. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/product-hero.json`
- [Feature Bento](https://kavynui.com/components/feature-bento): Four feature tiles, each with its own small live demo. Use case: Features section. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/feature-bento.json`
- [Proof Wall](https://kavynui.com/components/proof-wall): Logo marquee with a rotating customer quote. Use case: Social proof. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/proof-wall.json`
- [Pricing Morph](https://kavynui.com/components/pricing-morph): Plan cards reshape when billing changes. Use case: SaaS pricing. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/pricing-morph.json`
- [FAQ Accordion](https://kavynui.com/components/faq-accordion): One-open-at-a-time questions with a plus that becomes a minus. Use case: Pricing page FAQ. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/faq-accordion.json`
- [Globe CTA](https://kavynui.com/components/globe-cta): Closing call to action next to a live dotted globe. Use case: Bottom-of-page CTA. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/globe-cta.json`
- [Wordmark Footer](https://kavynui.com/components/wordmark-footer): Link columns over a giant wordmark that rises in. Use case: Site footer. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/wordmark-footer.json`
- [Changelog Feed](https://kavynui.com/components/changelog-feed): Release timeline whose entries expand in place. Use case: Changelog page. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/changelog-feed.json`
- [Sign-in Card](https://kavynui.com/components/sign-in-card): Magic-link sign-in with validation, shake and sent state. Use case: Auth screen. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/sign-in-card.json`
- [Status Board](https://kavynui.com/components/status-board): Overall system state plus 90-day history per service. Use case: Public status page. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/status-board.json`
- [Edge Dashboard](https://kavynui.com/components/edge-dashboard): Live analytics dashboard with stat tiles, request map and top countries. Use case: Admin overview. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/edge-dashboard.json`

## Buttons

- [Liquid Button](https://kavynui.com/components/liquid-button): Gooey blobs merge and split on hover. Use case: Primary CTA. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/liquid-button.json`
- [Magnet Pill](https://kavynui.com/components/magnet-pill): Label drifts toward the cursor, pill stretches back. Use case: Newsletter signup. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/magnet-pill.json`
- [Ink Bleed Button](https://kavynui.com/components/ink-bleed-button): Fill floods in from the exact entry point. Use case: Pricing CTA. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/ink-bleed-button.json`
- [Ember Button](https://kavynui.com/components/ember-button): Edge heat-shimmer builds as the cursor gets closer. Use case: Checkout "Pay now". Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/ember-button.json`
- [Orbit Button](https://kavynui.com/components/orbit-button): A spark orbits the border while work runs. Use case: AI "Generate". Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/orbit-button.json`
- [Hold to Confirm](https://kavynui.com/components/hold-to-confirm): Ring fills while held, then snaps to a check. Use case: Delete account. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/hold-to-confirm.json`

## Forms & inputs

- [Waitlist Form](https://kavynui.com/components/waitlist-form): Email capture with avatar stack social proof, live join count and success state. Use case: Landing page waitlists. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/waitlist-form.json`
- [Avatar Upload](https://kavynui.com/components/avatar-upload): Pick or drop a photo, see it cropped round, watch the ring fill, then replace or remove it. Use case: Profile photo in settings. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/avatar-upload.json`
- [Dropzone](https://kavynui.com/components/dropzone): File upload dropzone with per-file progress, retry and aggregate status. Use case: File upload flows. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/dropzone.json`
- [Quick Menu](https://kavynui.com/components/quick-menu): Inline pill that pops a quick option menu above it. Use case: Visibility and quick settings. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/quick-menu.json`

## Navigation

- [Pocket Nav](https://kavynui.com/components/pocket-nav): Nav folds into a floating pill on scroll. Use case: Long landing pages. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/pocket-nav.json`
- [Tab Lens](https://kavynui.com/components/tab-lens): A lens slides between items and magnifies. Use case: Marketing nav. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/tab-lens.json`
- [Dock Magnify](https://kavynui.com/components/dock-magnify): Icons grow with cursor distance on a spring. Use case: App launcher. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/dock-magnify.json`
- [Command Rail](https://kavynui.com/components/command-rail): Side rail with key hints, expands on hover. Use case: Dashboards. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/command-rail.json`
- [Crumb Fold](https://kavynui.com/components/crumb-fold): Deep breadcrumbs fold into dots. Use case: File manager. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/crumb-fold.json`
- [Stack Menu](https://kavynui.com/components/stack-menu): Menu items fan down like cards. Use case: Mobile menu. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/stack-menu.json`
- [Section Beads](https://kavynui.com/components/section-beads): Beads fill as you read each section. Use case: Docs pages. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/section-beads.json`
- [Snap Sheet](https://kavynui.com/components/snap-sheet): Bottom sheet with snap points. Use case: Mobile checkout. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/snap-sheet.json`
- [Flow Chips](https://kavynui.com/components/flow-chips): Filter chips reorder with FLIP motion. Use case: Store filters. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/flow-chips.json`
- [Stepper Morph](https://kavynui.com/components/stepper-morph): Step line morphs into a check. Use case: Onboarding. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/stepper-morph.json`
- [Workspace Shuffle](https://kavynui.com/components/workspace-shuffle): Workspaces slide in as a card stack. Use case: SaaS switcher. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/workspace-shuffle.json`

## Text

- [Flip Words](https://kavynui.com/components/flip-words): The last word rolls to the next, letter by letter. Use case: Hero tagline. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/flip-words.json`
- [Text Scramble](https://kavynui.com/components/text-scramble): Letters decode from noise, left to right, again on hover. Use case: Dev-tool headline. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/text-scramble.json`
- [Caret Rewrite](https://kavynui.com/components/caret-rewrite): Types, backspaces and retypes with a live caret. Use case: AI taglines. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/caret-rewrite.json`
- [Shimmer Text](https://kavynui.com/components/shimmer-text): A light band sweeps across muted text. Use case: "Thinking" label. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/shimmer-text.json`
- [Highlighter Sweep](https://kavynui.com/components/highlighter-sweep): A marker stroke draws under the key phrase. Use case: Blog emphasis. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/highlighter-sweep.json`
- [Odometer Figures](https://kavynui.com/components/odometer-figures): Digits roll with a mechanical overshoot. Use case: Revenue dashboard. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/odometer-figures.json`
- [Weight Wave](https://kavynui.com/components/weight-wave): Variable-font weight ripples under the cursor. Use case: Brand headline. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/weight-wave.json`
- [Dust Letters](https://kavynui.com/components/dust-letters): A headline of dust that scatters and drifts home. Use case: Brand hero. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/dust-letters.json`

- [Beam Border](https://kavynui.com/components/beam-border): A single beam travels around the card edge. Use case: Recommended plan. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/beam-border.json`
- [Ledger Bento](https://kavynui.com/components/ledger-bento): Finance cells update in place. Use case: Fintech features. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/ledger-bento.json`

- [Tilt Pass](https://kavynui.com/components/tilt-pass): Card tilts in 3D with glare that tracks light. Use case: Membership card. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/tilt-pass.json`

## Interactive

- [Expand Cards](https://kavynui.com/components/expand-cards): Panels share a row; the active one expands. Use case: Product pillars. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/expand-cards.json`
- [Morph Dialog](https://kavynui.com/components/morph-dialog): A card morphs into a dialog with a shared layout. Use case: Item details. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/morph-dialog.json`
- [Notification Stack](https://kavynui.com/components/notif-stack): Notifications pile up; tap to fan them out. Use case: Activity inbox. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/notif-stack.json`
- [Share Sheet](https://kavynui.com/components/share-sheet): Animated share sheet with social destinations, copy confirmation, real QR download, message and compact variants. Use case: Article sharing and product links. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/share-sheet.json`
- [Terminal Replay](https://kavynui.com/components/terminal-replay): Recorded terminal session with real timing. Use case: CLI docs. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/terminal-replay.json`
- [Before / After Blade](https://kavynui.com/components/before-after-blade): Angled blade wipes between two images. Use case: Photo editor. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/before-after-blade.json`
- [Lens Loupe](https://kavynui.com/components/lens-loupe): Magnifier follows the cursor with live zoom. Use case: Product photos. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/lens-loupe.json`
- [Isometric Stack](https://kavynui.com/components/isometric-stack): App layers separate isometrically on scroll. Use case: Infra "how it works". Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/isometric-stack.json`
- [Shortcut Caps](https://kavynui.com/components/shortcut-caps): Keycaps press in sequence to teach a shortcut. Use case: Docs hints. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/shortcut-caps.json`
- [Topic Bubbles](https://kavynui.com/components/topic-bubbles): Topics drop in with weight; tap to pick, drag to throw. Use case: Onboarding interests. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/topic-bubbles.json`

- [Edge Globe](https://kavynui.com/components/edge-globe): Rotating globe of real land dots with arcs. Drag to spin. Use case: Global presence. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/edge-globe.json`
- [Uptime Bars](https://kavynui.com/components/uptime-bars): 90-day status bars that rise in, with a per-day tooltip. Use case: Service health. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/uptime-bars.json`
- [Latency Stream](https://kavynui.com/components/latency-stream): Live latency line streaming from the right with an average. Use case: Performance widget. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/latency-stream.json`
- [Threat Feed](https://kavynui.com/components/threat-feed): Security events slide into a live list; hover pauses it. Use case: Firewall activity. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/threat-feed.json`
- [Region Bars](https://kavynui.com/components/region-bars): Top countries by traffic, re-ranking as shares shift. Use case: Traffic breakdown. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/region-bars.json`
- [Request Heatmap](https://kavynui.com/components/request-heatmap): Hour by weekday grid that fills on a diagonal wave. Use case: Usage patterns. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/request-heatmap.json`
- [Cache Ring](https://kavynui.com/components/cache-ring): Donut ring and number spring to each new ratio. Use case: Cache hit ratio. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/cache-ring.json`
- [Commit Grove](https://kavynui.com/components/commit-grove): Daily contribution calendar with a green intensity scale, keyboard day navigation and expanding workspace highlights. Use case: Developer profiles and team activity. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/commit-grove.json`
